name: Incidence Matrix Subspace Isomorphism
description: Frames the graph as a set of vectors e_u - e_v in R^n. The tree guarantee is mathematically encoded as having n-1 vectors whose span has dimension n-1 (i.e., rank of incidence matrix is n-1, meaning 1 connected component). Connectivity between a and b is encoded as e_a - e_b being in the span of the selected subset. This completely removes all graph vocabulary while remaining mathematically isomorphic, forcing the model to deduce the graph structure from linear algebraic properties to avoid an O(n^3) TLE.
